name: Confractosuchus
sum: Confractosuchus is a eusuchian crocodyliform from the Cretaceous Winton Formation of Australia, found with a juvenile ornithopod dinosaur in its stomach.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: A largely articulated skeleton lacking most of the pelvis and tail, from the Winton Formation of Queensland; catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
exceptional: Partly digested bones of a juvenile ornithopod dinosaur (a chicken-sized animal weighing about 1.7 kg) in the abdomen.
biology: Described as a macro-generalist predator; the stomach contents show it ate dinosaurs, and the species name means broken dinosaur killer.
author: White et al. 2022
